plugins.name: Medical & Psychometric Analytics
plugins.description: SSQ/NASA-TLX questionnaire scoring and a per-session biometric summary (mean heart rate, minimum boundary distance), computed out-of-process from live telemetry. Does not enforce GDPR consent and does not compute a stress score.

plugins.name: ROS 2 / Unity Bridge
plugins.description: Converts the live OpenXR HMD pose to ROS's coordinate convention and publishes geometry_msgs/PoseStamped via rosbridge_suite, for a Unity-simulated robotic arm. Requires a ROS 2 distribution and rosbridge_suite already installed on the workstation.
